newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Magician to set up bottle plant in Xian.
newsitem.headline: Magician to set up bottle plant in Xian.

text.p: Magician Industries (Holdings) Ltd said on Friday it was considering the establishment of a plastic bottle manufacturing plant in China's Xian but details of the project were still under discussion.
The company said it was "considering the proposed project with the company's joint venture partner in the company's existing plastic bottle manufacturing plant in Hangzhou."
It said "the timing of the proposed project and the company's financial commitment on the proposed project are still under discussion and no final decision has been reached."
Magician shares rose HK$0.10 or 4.82 percent to HK$2.175 in early trade. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
